summary: Full-stack testing of NEXORA. Backend: 15/16 pytest cases pass (94%). Frontend: public pages, quote configurator with live deterministic estimate, contact, booking, client/admin login, dashboards, and route guards all working. Two CRITICAL security requirements (admin-only endpoints reject client tokens with 403; cross-client data isolation returns empty lists) both PASS. Minor issues: admin-login-with-client-creds does not show 'administrators only' toast (useEffect races), brute-force lockout is flaky in tests, React key warning on Leads list. Emergent-managed email currently reporting 'sent=false' path in some quote submissions (frontend UI hints 'email confirmation is pending').

minor.issue: check_lockout compares Mongo-returned locked_until (possibly tz-naive) with tz-aware datetime; brute-force lockout worked in one run and did not in a later run (flaky). Verify motor tz handling / normalize datetime.

Emergent-managed Resend send appears to sometimes return no email_id, showing 'email confirmation is pending' banner on the success screen. Check emailer error handling / API key. Data still persisted correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: When client credentials are entered on /admin/login, AuthContext sets user first and useEffect navigates to /dashboard before the 'This login is for administrators only.' error can render. Reorder logic: if admin && role!==admin, call logout() (or don't setUser) before showing error, OR gate the useEffect on !error.
React warning: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop.' in Leads render (likely missing key on Card children).

action_items: Fix Login.jsx admin flow: after login, if admin flag set and role !== admin, prevent auto-redirect (e.g., call logout or set a local block, or move the check into the effect). Ensures the 'administrators only' error is visible.

Normalize datetime handling in core.check_lockout: ensure locked_until is timezone-aware when comparing (e.g., if locked_until.tzinfo is None: locked_until = locked_until.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)).
Investigate emailer.send_email failure path for quote submissions (Emergent Resend) — the client sees 'email confirmation is pending' banner. Check backend logs and Resend configuration.
Add unique keys in AdminDashboard Leads list render to remove React warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py exception handler swallows all exceptions with a generic 500 — good for prod, but hides real stack traces during dev; consider logging traceback with logger.exception.
rate_limit uses a global in-memory deque — will not survive process restarts or scale across replicas; acceptable for MVP.
check_lockout has a subtle tz-naive vs tz-aware datetime comparison; may raise or silently skip lock-check depending on motor config.
routes_client.messages does not scope by client_id when sending admin messages back, but overall client_id scoping in listing endpoints is correctly enforced.
public_user response includes 'created_at' which is fine; no secrets leaked in API responses per inspection.
The frontend Login effect auto-navigates once user is set, causing the admin-login guard message to never render — see action items.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all key flows OK, one minor UX bug)

context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py contains 16 cases with module-scoped admin/client session fixtures that auto-retry on 429. If run back-to-back, sleep ~65s between runs to let login rate-limit window expire. The two CRITICAL security tests (test_admin_endpoints_forbidden_for_client and test_cross_client_isolation) both pass. brute-force lockout test may be flaky depending on prior state — treat as advisory unless server-side datetime fix is applied.
rca_of_the_issue: Admin-login-with-client-creds UX bug: In Login.jsx, useAuth.login() sets user state on successful auth. A useEffect watching user then triggers navigate() to the role-appropriate dashboard BEFORE the submit handler's admin-role check can setError. So a client hitting /admin/login is silently redirected to /dashboard (still safe since backend enforces admin) instead of seeing 'This login is for administrators only.'. Fix: either don't setUser when admin flag mismatches, call logout() and clear cookies before setError, or make the useEffect skip when the admin prop is true and role !== 'admin'.
